headline: Ex-Cantonment OC arrested in sedition case over leaked audio
summary: Former Cantonment Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md. Rakibul Hasan has been placed on a 5-day remand following his arrest for allegedly spreading anti-state remarks.
details: A Dhaka court has ordered a 5-day remand for former Cantonment Police Station OC Md. Rakibul Hasan in connection with a sedition case. The order was given by Metropolitan Magistrate Didarul Alam on Thursday night.
caption:
A former police chief is in custody. Ex-Cantonment OC Rakibul Hasan faces sedition charges after a viral audio clip surfaced.

A Dhaka court has ordered a 5-day remand for former Cantonment Police Station OC Md. Rakibul Hasan in connection with a sedition case. The order was given by Metropolitan Magistrate Didarul Alam on Thursday night.

headline_marked: Woman dead, 4 missing after [[trawler sinks in Meghna River]]
headline: Woman dead, 4 missing after trawler sinks in Meghna River
summary: The accident occurred in Narayanganj's Sonargaon as passengers were traveling to a wedding ceremony in Comilla.
details: A woman has been found dead and four people remain missing after a trawler sank in the Meghna River in Sonargaon, Narayanganj.
The accident happened on Thursday afternoon in the Baidyer Bazar Sonamoyee area while passengers were heading to a relative's house in Comilla to attend a wedding.
The trawler was carrying 13 passengers, including livestock such as cows and goats, when it was caught in a storm and capsized.
Another trawler nearby quickly responded to the scene, rescuing nine people alive and recovering the body of a woman named Rashida.
Four members of the same family—Helal Uddin, Sajib, Samia, and Samin—are still missing and search efforts are underway.
caption:
A wedding journey turns into tragedy as a trawler sinks in the Meghna River, leaving one dead and four missing.

A woman has been found dead and four people remain missing after a trawler sank in the Meghna River in Sonargaon, Narayanganj.

The accident happened on Thursday afternoon in the Baidyer Bazar Sonamoyee area while passengers were heading to a relative's house in Comilla to attend a wedding.

The trawler was carrying 13 passengers, including livestock such as cows and goats, when it was caught in a storm and capsized.

Another trawler nearby quickly responded to the scene, rescuing nine people alive and recovering the body of a woman named Rashida.

Four members of the same family—Helal Uddin, Sajib, Samia, and Samin—are still missing and search efforts are underway.

#Bangladesh #Narayanganj #MeghnaRiver #Accident #BreakingNews

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
